experiment.title: 16-bit projective relation-batch rank completion
experiment.objective: Test whether expanding the deterministic relation target batch from B+1 to 2B+1 restores the missing 16-bit relation rank.
stopping_rules: charge every added target and comparator
do not treat rank completion as individual-log descent
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidation_rules: invalidate if clean verifier or rho certificates fail
preserve rank failure as a scoped negative
experiment.success_criterion: Full projective support, witnesses, rho, homogeneous scaling, weighted comparator advantage, and rank 15 pass independently.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Any full-control failure, rank below 15, weighted reversal, or verifier failure.
